title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
description:
Mechanical Engineer – Motor Accident Inspection & Forensic Investigation

**Company Name:**
Code F Solutions Private Limited

**Department:**
Motor Investigation & Forensic Services

**Job Location:**
Nagpur, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

1. About Code F Solutions

Code F Solutions Private Limited is a forensic and investigation services company providing specialized solutions in forensic science, cyber forensics, motor accident investigation, and technical investigation services.

We are looking for a technically skilled and detail-oriented Mechanical Engineer to join our team and contribute to motor accident inspections, vehicle damage analysis, and forensic investigation assignments.

2. Job Responsibilities

* Conduct physical inspections of vehicles involved in road accidents.
* Examine vehicle damage, impact points, and mechanical components.
* Analyze accident-related evidence and identify possible causes of vehicle damage.
* Inspect damaged vehicles and document relevant technical observations.
* Prepare detailed inspection reports supported by photographs and technical findings.
* Conduct site visits and vehicle inspections at workshops, garages, accident locations, and other assigned locations.
* Assist in accident reconstruction and forensic investigation activities.
* Coordinate with the internal investigation team, field officers, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate records, photographs, and case documentation.
* Complete assigned investigations and submit reports within the prescribed timelines.
* Travel as required for field inspections and investigation assignments.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
* Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
* Knowledge of automobile engineering, vehicle systems, and mechanical components will be an advantage.

4. Required Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Knowledge of automobile mechanics and vehicle damage assessment.
* Good observation and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to prepare clear and structured technical reports.
* Proficiency in MS Office and basic computer applications.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections.
* Attention to detail, professional integrity, and a responsible approach to investigations.

5. Preferred Experience

* Experience in automobile workshops, vehicle inspection, motor insurance, accident investigation, or automobile damage assessment will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

6. What We Offer

* Practical exposure to motor accident investigation and forensic services.
* Opportunities to work on real-world vehicle inspection cases.
* Professional learning and skill development.
* An opportunity to build a career at the intersection of mechanical engineering, insurance investigation, and forensic analysis.
